name: AWEI T56 ANC  Earbuds With Screen Intelligent Interaction ( 6-Month Official Warranty )
description:
Touch Color Screen: Large screen allows easy control of playback, dial, volume, EQ, screen brightness, wallpaper selection, spatial sound effects, and more.

Adaptive ANC (Active Noise Cancellation): Depth > -35dB for crystal-clear sound even in noisy environments.

Double Bass Sound: 10mm drivers deliver deep bass, rich mids, and crisp highs.

Bluetooth 5.4 & Protocols: JL 7006F8 chip; supports A2DP, AVRCP, HSP, HFP for stable, low-latency audio.

Battery & Charging:

Earbuds: 35mAh × 2, 1.5h charging time

Charging Case: 500mAh, 2.5h charging time

Play Time: 5 hours | Talk Time: 4 hours

Waterproof: IPX6 rating, ideal for workouts and outdoor use.

Wearing Style: In-ear with multiple ear tip sizes for a secure and comfortable fit.

Extras: Earphone search, flashlight, timer/stopwatch, power display, language switching.

📦 Package Includes

1 × Pair of Earbuds

1 × Charging Case

1 × USB Type-C Cable

1 × Large & Small Earplugs

1 × User Manual (Chinese & English)
